summary: Meera cold-called Mr Raghav to discuss consolidating expense and payables processes. Raghav was receptive, mentioned a colleague in people operations who handles frontline processes and locations, and who may have been looking at a similar solution. Provided email: contact08@example.com.
key_findings: Warm reception — prospect engaged and provided referral.
Internal champion potential: colleague in people ops may already be looking for a solution.
SpendNest was positioned as complementing existing enterprise systems.

evidence.text: The colleague handling our people operations also deals with frontline processes and the locations. I think we may have been looking at a solution, but I don't know the details.
If you send him a proposal and say you spoke with me, he can take a look.

next_actions: Send proposal to contact08@example.com mentioning Raghav's referral.
Focus proposal on payment execution, cards, and location-level expense management.
coaching_notes: Good call by Meera. Getting a referral to the right person is valuable. The mention of 'may have been looking at a solution' suggests existing pain. Follow-up should be prompt.
